text_block_list.text:
What reached my ears was Ikuno Dictus's voice,
sounding unusually formal. ...Looking over, even Symboli Rudolf is there with an urgent expression.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
From what I've heard, we have no time to spare.
I believe this is a matter that must be addressed as expeditiously as possible.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. However, this is our first attempt at such a thing.
Where on earth should we begin...?

Things seem to be getting pretty tense...!
For Symboli Rudolf to be troubled like this, something extraordinary must have happened.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's all right, please don't worry. I will draw up a schedule
and manage everything leading up to the tournament.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: No matter what the matter may be, so long as the person is taking it seriously, I wish to lend a helping hand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus... Truly a welcome rain during a drought.
I cannot thank you enough for your cooperation.
I will give it my all in the competition to ensure it does not go to waste.

Just as my conversation with Symboli Rudolf ended,
Ikuno Dictus noticed me.
choice_data_list: It seemed like you were having a serious talk, but...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes... To think that council president would consult us so openly.
She must be taking this weekend's battle truly seriously.
choice_data_list: (Just what kind of battle was that...)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"If that is how it must be, I will travel to the venue myself
and see the outcome through to the end.
As my duty as an advisor."
Ikuno Dictus's expression held a seriousness that was every bit the equal of Symboli Rudolf's.
And when the weekend arrived—curious about the exchange between Ikuno Dictus and Symboli Rudolf, I tagged along to this rumored "tournament."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "I had been waiting for this day with bated breath, but... when I'm actually standing before the stage... I can't help feeling anxious."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You've trained thoroughly.
I'm sure everything will go well. Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District PA
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Entry Number 1,
whenever you're ready, go right ahead!!

The lively atmosphere suddenly shifted—
The venue fell into such total silence
that you could almost hear the heartbeat of every single spectator.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text: ......I'm gonna sell veggies at the festival eve!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (BWAHAHAHA!!)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District PA
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! A smash hit right off the bat!
The 'Shopping District Pun Contest' is at a really high level this year!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District PA
text_block_list.text:
And now, we have an entry all the way from Tracen Academy!
Entry Number 7: Symboli Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Let us go.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Word is, the "Emperor" is all for embracing the process of constructing the campus grounds with uneven elevations!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Ahahahahaha!!)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District PA
text_block_list.text:
"This is incredible! It's a huge hit!!
Her technical score is exceptionally high too!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...That's just like you, President.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on your victory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I'm surprised myself. Technical score, vocal score, sharpness—I received high praise across all categories.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The strategy of “challenging them head-on with dignity” paid off.
If you shrink back, the crowd picks up on it too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Creating an atmosphere where people can genuinely smile...
That is more important than anything else.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly impressed by your management.
I had a hard time finding someone to consult with
for this tournament, you see.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed, finding someone to consult about puns
must be quite difficult.
I am not particularly adept at punning myself, after all."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: However, that is not what's important. What matters is how serious, how sincere one is—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Because Madam President was facing it with such sincerity,
I wanted to support her with that same passion.
That is all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah... You were a real lifesaver.

...No matter what the task, I feel I've learned the importance
of taking it seriously and putting in genuine effort.
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to both of your hard work!
It's all thanks to both of your hard work!
Do you want to keep this up and aim for victory next time too?

text_block_list.text:
...No matter what the task, I feel I've learned the importance
of taking it seriously and putting in genuine effort.
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to both of your hard work!
It's all thanks to both of your hard work!
Do you want to keep this up and aim for victory next time too?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that is true.
It is the result of both of us giving our absolute all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, indeed. Then let us wrap things up
with my absolute best pun!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I won today's race in this kind of shopping district!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Your winning pun was on point too!
Once again, I was reminded of just how incredible Ikuno Dictus's management skills are.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I anticipated you might do that,
so I have already formulated a plan."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, impressive as always.
I shall redouble my efforts for the next one as well!

Ikuno Dictus's attitude of always preparing for what comes next.
I couldn't help but be deeply impressed.
